# SANOCEA™ — AI-Assisted Ecommerce Operations Layer
> Operational exception automation across catalogue, inventory, pricing, orders, fulfilment, reconciliation, and marketplace exceptions — with humans in control of important decisions.

## Canonical Modules & Solutions
- [Commerce Command Center](/demo.html): Unified operations dashboard and WhatsApp decision layer.
- [Marketplace Reconciliation](/solutions/marketplace-reconciliation/): Automated settlement deduction auditing across Amazon, Flipkart, and Blinkit.
- [Operational Domains](/#operations): Catalogue suppression prevention, inventory drift sync, MAP pricing guardrails, stuck order triage, and NDR courier SLA management.

## Contact & Governance
- Website: https://www.sanocea.com/
- Inquiries: hello@sanocea.com
- Security & Human Governance: High-stakes pricing, refunds, and dark store inventory transfers require explicit operator approval.
